unsupported: Freudenberg Medical is headquartered in Minnetonka, Minnesota, and operates as the medical division of the Freudenberg Group, a privately held company with more than 175 years of experience developing high-performance materials.

Its core capabilities include silicone molding and extrusion, scientific thermoplastic injection molding and extrusion, precision metal component manufacturing (tubing, hypotubes, and specialty needles), and advanced surface modifications such as hydrophilic and drug coatings.
